responsibility: Implements GCC’s decimal floating-point support for REAL_VALUE_TYPE using the decNumber/decimal32/64/128 libraries. It converts between GCC internal real values and IEEE 754 decimal encodings, parses and prints decimal constants, performs decimal arithmetic, rounding, comparisons, truncation and integer conversion, and handles endianness and mode-specific maximum values for the decimal floating-point modes.
same_name_distinction: Provides the actual decimal floating-point implementation, including conversions to and from decimal32/64/128 encodings and decNumber-based arithmetic on REAL_VALUE_TYPE values; unlike gcc/dfp.h, it contains the executable logic rather than just the exported decimal helper declarations.
